Note GPT scored 'verbatim' here and the human 'partial' -- grounding measures vocabulary overlap and cannot detect a value answering the wrong question. Context: env_local_scale is inherited from the ENA/MIxS schema and is poorly defined in its documentation, expecting an ENVO environmental-context term that fits field and environmental sampling far better than a controlled laboratory plant study.
